To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the weight matrix of a trained neural network can be analysed to determine the significance of inputs, (2) the magnitude of the weight is not a good measure of input significance, (3) functional analysis can provide a more accurate measure of significance than the magnitude, and (4) sensitivity analysis is not a reliable measure for determining input significance.
